title: Consume the European 64-byte constructor template
changes: Publish the authenticated 64-byte EUR constructor template as sixteen little-endian words and serve its source reads from the managed dataset while the guest retains allocation and live writes.
Preserve prior resources, bounded dataset validation and unchanged USA revision; expose source-use counters and retain the existing reader routing.
validation: Source n33tj6pd authenticates the template and original fixed-length copy. Wine nibv6hif preserves 116 earlier resources and passes poisoned boundary/mirror reads and interpreter versus compiled original copy including full state and guest clock.

Wine 2efs1kas matches state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio across 600 recorded frames with all 64 source bytes altered; the managed owner serves 256 bytes. Wine CLI 0qyhd6ao creates, reuses and verifies 118 matching files.
Wine servers drained. Initial source attempt hr0chmaj used an unresolved generation placeholder; initial build grl6fsjd used a path relative to scratch. Both were corrected before passing checks.
limitations: The observed scene does not identify its dynamic caller; unclassified fields, additional consumers and 3856 other bytes in the E172 sample remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows checks remain pending. No performance measurements were performed.
